_readme: Config manifest for the homepage intro. Animation: leader.json (Lottie). Video fallback: preloader.webm + preloader.mov. Run npm run development to copy assets to assets/preloader/. Set enabled: false to disable entirely.
_encodeSafari: Safari <video> needs HEVC with alpha (hvc1), NOT ProRes 4444. From ProRes source: ffmpeg -y -i preloader-prores.mov -vf format=yuva420p -c:v hevc_videotoolbox -b:v 8M -alpha_quality 1 -tag:v hvc1 -an preloader.mov. Verify: ffprobe shows codec_name=hevc, codec_tag_string=hvc1.
_encodeWebm: Chrome/Firefox: ffmpeg -y -i source.mov -c:v libvpx-vp9 -pix_fmt yuva420p -b:v 2M -an preloader.webm
